title: ME60084: Hydel Power And Wind Energy
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Hydel Power: Stream flow data and water power estimates, use of hydrographs;
hydraulic turbine, characteristics and part load performance, design of wheels,
draft tubes and penstocks, cavitation; plant layouts; costing of water
power.Wind Power and Engineering: Estimates of wind energy potential, wind
maps; aerodynamic and mechanical aspects of wind machine design; wind tunnel
simulations, conversion and storage methods; industrial applications.
Instrumentation for wind velocity measurements.
